Callout.Name: Air Support - Roof Assault
Callout.Message: Suspect on a roof, ground units unable to reach.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect, armed, refusing to come down.

Script.Line: Do not come up here. I mean it.
I can see the whole street from up here. You are not surrounding anything.
Put the aircraft off me and I will talk to you.

Stages.Stage: Weapon down and on their knees.

Lines.Approach: They are on the roof and the only way up is the air unit. Ground teams have the building.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
